Madou Monogatari I - 3tsu no Madoukyuu.name: Madou Monogatari I: 3tsu no Madoukyuu
Madou Monogatari I - 3tsu no Madoukyuu.summary: Madou Monogatari I: 3tsu no Madoukyuu is a role-playing game for the Sega Game Gear released as part of Compile's Madou Monogatari series, specifically in the first "1-2-3" entry. A different version of this game was released on the Mega Drive Madou Monogatari I.
